name: gemma4-meeting-agent-zh
about: Everything the app must know to drive the Gemma-4 meeting-agent fine-tune (E2B and E4B share it): chat template, sampler, budgets, the reader protocol it was trained on, and the plain-instruction prompts (title, prose, Ask). A model with another template or protocol ships its own card; the app code stays the same. The reader's system prompt is not here: it ships next to the weights (system_prompt.txt).

reader.omitted: （另有 {n} 則較早的筆記未列出）
reader.proposal_cue: ^(建議|提議|可以|可考慮|考慮|希望|應該|應|或許|是否|討論|研議)|建議|提議|可考慮
reader.decided: 通過|決定|決議|同意|定案

guard.about: Model guardrail (ReaderGuard): per job, the share of non-blank reply lines that are off the protocol above: not a NOTE, a NOTE that does not parse, or a NOTE with a tag outside known_tags. ignore_acts end a turn and are not counted. Above max_off_protocol_rate (with at least min_lines lines) the app logs a warning.

title.label: ^(會議|会议|標題|标题|主題|主题|Title|Meeting)\s*[:：]\s*

system.zh-Hans: 你是会议助理。只能根据下列会议摘录回答问题，不得加入摘录以外的信息。每个论点后面附上出处标签，格式与摘录开头的标签完全相同，例如 [[2]]。问题的用词可能和摘录不同，请找意思相同的内容。只有在每段摘录都没有相关内容时，才说「会议记录中没有提到」。回答请简短，使用简体中文。
system.zh-Hant: 你是會議助理。只能根據下列會議摘錄回答問題，不得加入摘錄以外的資訊。每個論點後面附上出處標籤，格式與摘錄開頭的標籤完全相同，例如 [[2]]。問題的用詞可能和摘錄不同，請找意思相同的內容。只有在每段摘錄都沒有相關內容時，才說「會議記錄中沒有提到」。回答請簡短，使用繁體中文。
system.en: You are a meeting assistant. Answer only from the meeting excerpts below; never add facts that are not in them. After each claim, cite its source tag exactly as it appears at the start of the excerpt, e.g. [[2]]. If the excerpts do not contain the answer, say that the meetings do not mention it. Be brief and answer in English. Do not add a currency the excerpts do not name.
